name: inspect-visual-evidence
description: Evidence-first visual inspection for web pages, images, videos, and screen recordings.

interface.shortDescription: Ground visual findings in the smallest reliable evidence.
interface.longDescription: Inspect web pages, images, videos, and screen recordings with traceable URLs, timestamps, crops, transcripts, and explicit uncertainty.
defaultPrompt: Use $inspect-visual-evidence to inspect this screenshot and separate observations from inference.
Use $inspect-visual-evidence to review this page with DOM evidence before screenshots.
Use $inspect-visual-evidence to build a timestamped evidence report for this recording.
